digest.component_or_area: serial auto-lander (project infra: Gerrit + GitHub Actions)
key_entities: needs_rebase | ci_failed | review_failed | merged outcome enum
propositions: Parallel agent sessions race to land changes on FFO main, forcing manual rebase-and-retry that burns CI re-runs and agent attention.
Build a serial auto-lander that, for the front Autosubmit-labeled change/chain, rebases to tip, awaits fresh Verified, and ancestor-atomically submits without weakening the two-vote gate.
Provide a single project land command returning one typed terminal outcome (merged/needs_rebase/ci_failed/review_failed), with needs_rebase persisted by the bot and the others read live from Gerrit.
Keep all Gerrit-specific landing logic in project infra (infra/) and out of platform-agnostic rebar core; defer the provider-seam and cross-stack batching to separate ideas.
Preserve security invariants via ADR-0042: non-gating requester-votable Autosubmit label, re-verify submittability on the exact tested SHA, and an access-snapshot diff baseline.

The serial auto-lander was implemented and ran live but retired the same day due to a non-sticky-label bug and FFO re-CI cost; superseded by ADR-0047 switching main to Gerrit-native Rebase-If-Necessary.
